rollups.text: Exercise and sports mentioned by the user: gym sessions, usually Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays (2023-02-11; gym time was said to be 7:00 pm then, and usually 6:00 pm on 2023-05-30); tennis, biking, swimming, and yoga (2023-03-22; yoga on Mondays and Wednesdays); and participation in a charity run on 2023-04-23. The user also considered training for a spring triathlon, but did not confirm a specific training plan or race.

Minecraft mod-download YouTube video: on 2023-01-20, the user was developing a video, wanted to showcase several mods near the beginning, requested an outline and explanations of mods and how to find them, and worked on its hook and thumbnail. The user chose a hook about customizing a Minecraft world and asked to include it in the outline. The video’s completion or publication was not reported.

Watercolor learning: the user began an online watercolor class on 2023-01-15 and described themself as a beginner by 2023-01-26. They said they took up watercolor to try something creative, found it calming, and were experimenting while developing a personal style. They explored brush sets and paper types; no specific purchase was confirmed.

StudIQ semester-notes page: by 2023-03-11, the user had created a semester-based notes page. Selecting a branch on the Browser page leads to the Semesters home page; semester buttons appear on the left, the fifth semester is the default, and its subjects appear in the center. The user also requested project test cases and specified that their table include status, error, and result fields. The project’s later status is unknown.

Computer vision and multimodal research direction: on 2023-05-25, the user considered pursuing a research position in a professor’s lab and wanted to discuss NLP projects. They cited a computer science background and master’s coursework in Advanced Machine Learning, Computer Vision, and Human-Computer Interaction, expressed particular interest in multimodal language processing, and selected Multimodal Conversational AI as an idea to explore. No application or research position was confirmed.

Explainable AI learning plan: the user has a computer science background and completed Coursera data science and machine-learning certifications in 2017. On 2023-04-23, while working as a product manager at a fintech company, the user said they would enroll in IBM’s Coursera course *Explainable AI for Business* and was also considering the University of Michigan’s Coursera *Explainable AI* course. Neither enrollment nor completion was confirmed.

1913 Liberty Head nickel care and appraisal: on 2023-03-23, the user reported owning the coin and asked about preserving it and market value. On 2023-04-29, the user said it came from an online dealer in Germany, was stored in a bank safe deposit box, and that they intended to move it to a more secure location soon; they also said their rare items were genuine and documented. Authentication, appraisal, and any move were not confirmed as completed.

Appraisals and care for other antiques: on 2023-03-23, the user planned to have an early-1900s family-crest pocket watch appraised and research its history, considering appraisers through NAWCC and AWCI. On 2023-04-29, the user said a local expert appointment was scheduled for a great-grandfather’s antique violin, planned a separate Asian-antique expert for an 18th-century Chinese vase, and wanted an inherited 1960s Omega Seamaster appraised, insured, and serviced. Outcomes were not reported.

Photo organization and camera care: the user owns a Canon EOS 5D Mark IV. Its sensor was professionally cleaned at a downtown camera store in April 2023; on 2023-05-24, the user was considering learning to clean it and said they would start with a Visible Dust Arctic Butterfly 724 kit, but purchase or use was unconfirmed. The user also planned to organize old albums, scan favorite prints, and better organize digital photographs scattered across folders and hard drives; completion was not reported.

Laptop protection: on 2023-03-15, the user bought a black padded Lenovo bag from Amazon for about $40, sized for a 15.6-inch laptop, and said it was working well. On 2023-05-14, the user sought an additional sleeve, aiming to spend $20–$30; the Tom Bihn Cache was too expensive, and the user planned to review less expensive options. The user mentioned a previous coffee spill and asked whether a sleeve would protect against another spill. No sleeve purchase was reported.

Bedroom and closet organization: the user replaced an old broken dresser with an IKEA dresser on 2022-03-12; on 2023-05-30, the user said their brother helped assemble it and that it provided extra storage. The user likes Scandinavian Minimalism, woven baskets, and natural textiles. After cleaning out their closet, the user planned to categorize clothes, use a closet system, and possibly use woven baskets for socks and underwear; completion was not reported.

Living-room lighting: on 2023-04-19, the user reported that living-room smart bulbs sometimes failed to respond and planned to troubleshoot them; brand and outcome were not reported. The user was interested in more reliable smart bulbs, considered IKEA floor lamps seen the preceding weekend, and wanted lamp shades that would complement the decor without obstructing the smart-bulb signal. The user was also considering changing cool-white living-room bulbs to warm white. Separately, the user said a warmer bedside-lamp bulb had made a big difference in the morning.

The user reported a regular gym schedule on two occasions: on 2023-02-11, usually Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays at 7:00 pm; on 2023-05-30, usually Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays at 6:00 pm. The recurring days stayed the same, while the stated usual time changed from 7:00 pm to 6:00 pm.
